title: Irish Onion and Yellow Dal Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ireland, blending the sweetness of yellow dal with caramelized onions.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the yellow dal and 4 cups of water to the pan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the glassy jelly and dried Irish Onion for thickening and extra flavor.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
